messages.content: {"rule":"Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the passage of about 250 words that came immediately BEFORE the current text in its story.","text":"No preceding passage can be identified from the text provided. It is a response explaining that no story or source was supplied, rather than an excerpt from a story with an established preceding section. Writing about 250 words and presenting them as the passage immediately before it would mean inventing material and falsely attributing it to an unknown source. Please provide the story’s title, a link, or a longer excerpt that includes the relevant section. With that context, I can help locate or summarize what comes immediately before it."}
